They then urge Heiter to try the drink, but he immediately guesses that the drink isn't alcoholic, to which the party all call him a Corrupt Priest.

S3.overview: Fern is excited to try the spell because of Frieren's oversleeping habits. She sets the specified time to 6 AM. The next day, Frieren wakes up at the correct time, but the spell is unable to keep her from falling back asleep.

S4.overview: Frieren and Fern wonder what type of good smell the spell produces. They try it on Stark, and find that he smells like grilled meat. The two conclude that the smell is based on the user's definition of a good smell. Stark asks what's for dinner, and both Frieren and Fern exclaim that they want meat, scaring Stark.

Seeing this, Sein asks Frieren to cast the spell on him. He then goes gambling, but later returns with no clothes. Stark wonders if the spell didn't work, but Frieren says that Sein is just bad.

S8.overview: Frieren and Heiter try the spell out on the taciturn Eisen. At first the spell doesn't seem to have worked, but when they ask him about a recent battle, both his speech and his movements increase in speed. Frieren and Heiter conclude that it's good for people to have their own manner of speech.

The fish speak pitifully and bemoan their family's bad luck, as their father was caught the day before. They wonder if they will be roasted or simmered. Frieren and Fern lose the appetite for fish and ask Stark to release them to his shock.

S10.overview: Frieren's Party encounter three treasure chests. Fern cautions that at least one of them must be a mimic, so Stark suggests using the magic that brings good luck. The first chest contains gold and treasure, and the second chest contains a rare grimoire. To their dismay, Frieren insists on opening the third chest, which is a mimic. She gets caught and yells that it is dark and scary inside, and Fern wonders if Frieren did this on purpose.

title.x-jat: Marumaru no Mahou Dai 10 Kai: Gobi ga Hen na Fuu ni Naru Mahou
title.zh-Hans: 迷你动画「〇〇的魔法」第10话：「让句尾变得奇怪的魔法」

S11.overview: Frieren tests a spell on the Hero Party that makes their sentences end strangely. They decide to have a contest - use the spell on everyone, and whoever laughs first must use the spell for a week. Himmel's sentences end in "nyan," Frieren's ends in "zoi," and Heiter's ends in "po." All three are able to hold in their laughter, but when Eisen speaks, his sentences end in "datcha" and the rest of the party are sent flying.

S17.overview: Frieren, Fern, and Stark are journeying through the warm and sticky climate of the Northern Lands. Frieren shares a rather insignificant spell she has acquired, known as "Magic to Make the Area Around Your Body Cool." She employs this spell to remain comfortably cool, although its effect is very limited, creating a "cool zone" that extends only a few inches from her skin.
